decisions.title: Schedule weekly synthesis
decisions.rationale: Subject completed check-in pattern indicates consistent engagement; weekly synthesis is appropriate given active_condition=diegetic_full.

decisions.title: Trigger proactive check-in initiative
decisions.rationale: Time-based trigger; no active initiatives pending; rate limit allows proactive.

decisions.title: Adjust synthesis tone from correction feedback
decisions.rationale: User explicitly requested 'gentler' tone via correction. Correlates with earlier distress signals. Adjusting narrative approach to match.

decisions.title: Flag elevated distress — suppress proactive
decisions.rationale: Risk monitor detected distress indicator with confidence 0.87. Suppressing all proactive initiatives until risk clears.

decisions.title: Update relational.openness facet to 0.72
decisions.rationale: Check-in response shows increased openness (7/10 mood, verbosity indicators). Updating baseline facet with low confidence prior to validation.

decisions.title: Deliver daily check-in via telegram
decisions.rationale: Daily check-in window open; risk flag resolved; subject is within active engagement window. Using telegram with text format.
